segments.sn22.59:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bārāṇasiyaṃ viharati isipatane migadāye.
segments.sn22.59:1.2: Tatra kho bhagavā pañcavaggiye bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn22.59:2.2: Rūpañca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca rūpe –
segments.sn22.59:2.3: ‘evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
segments.sn22.59:2.4: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ anattā, tasmā rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati rūpe –
segments.sn22.59:2.5: ‘evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’”ti.
segments.sn22.59:3.2: Vedanā ca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ vedanā ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca vedanāya –
segments.sn22.59:3.3: ‘evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’ti.
segments.sn22.59:3.4: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, vedanā anattā, tasmā vedanā ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati vedanāya –
segments.sn22.59:3.5: ‘evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’”ti.
segments.sn22.59:4.3: Saṅkhārā ca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissaṃsu, nayidaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṅkhāresu –
segments.sn22.59:4.4: ‘evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun’ti.
segments.sn22.59:4.5: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, saṅkhārā anattā, tasmā saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvattanti, na ca labbhati saṅkhāresu –
segments.sn22.59:4.6: ‘evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā mā ahesun’”ti.
segments.sn22.59:5.2: Viññāṇañca hidaṃ, bhikkhave, attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca viññāṇe –
segments.sn22.59:5.3: ‘evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
segments.sn22.59:5.4: Yasmā ca kho, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ anattā, tasmā viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati viññāṇe –
segments.sn22.59:5.5: ‘evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosī’”ti.
segments.sn22.59:6.1: “Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.59:6.4: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.59:6.6: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn22.59:6.9: “Vedanā … saññā … saṅkhārā … viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.59:6.14: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā”ti?
segments.sn22.59:6.16: “Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ –
segments.sn22.59:7.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhave, yaṃ kiñci rūpaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ rūpaṃ – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn22.59:8.1: Yā kāci vedanā atītānāgatapaccuppannā ajjhattā vā bahiddhā vā … pe … yā dūre santike vā, sabbā vedanā – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn22.59:9.1: “Yā kāci saññā … pe … ye keci saṅkhārā atītānāgatapaccuppannā ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā … pe … ye dūre santike vā, sabbe saṅkhārā –
segments.sn22.59:9.2: ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn22.59:10.1: “Yaṃ kiñci viññāṇaṃ atītānāgatapaccuppannaṃ ajjhattaṃ vā bahiddhā vā oḷārikaṃ vā sukhumaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā yaṃ dūre santike vā, sabbaṃ viññāṇaṃ – ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṃ.
segments.sn22.59:11.1: “Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati, saññāyapi nibbindati, saṅkhāresupi nibbindati, viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
segments.sn22.59:11.2: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati. Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.sn22.59:11.3: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
segments.sn22.59:12.2: Attamanā pañcavaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ [abhinandunti (ka.)].
segments.sn22.59:12.3: Imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne pañcavaggiyānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti.

lines: Sattame pañcavaggiyeti aññāsi koṇḍaññattherādike pañca jane purāṇupaṭṭhāke.
Āmantesīti āsāḷhipuṇṇamadivase dhammacakkappavattanato paṭṭhāya anukkamena sotāpattiphale patiṭṭhite “idāni nesaṃ āsavakkhayāya dhammaṃ desessāmī”ti pañcamiyaṃ pakkhassa āmantesi.
Tattha anattāti pubbe vuttehi catūhi kāraṇehi anattā.
Taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhaveti idaṃ kasmā āraddhaṃ?
Ettakena ṭhānena anattalakkhaṇameva kathitaṃ, na aniccadukkhalakkhaṇāni, idāni tāni dassetvā samodhānetvā tīṇipi lakkhaṇāni dassetuṃ idamāraddhanti veditabbaṃ.
Tasmāti yasmā ime pañcakkhandhā aniccā dukkhā anattā, tasmā.
Yaṃkiñci rūpantiādīsu vitthārakathā visuddhimagge paññābhāvanādhikāre khandhaniddese vuttāva.
Ettakena ṭhānenāti “rūpaṃ, bhikkhave, anattā”ti ārabhitvā yāva “evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosī”ti ettakena suttapadesena.
Akathitasseva kathanaṃ uttaraṃ, na kathitassāti vuttaṃ “tāni dassetvā”ti.
Aniccatādīnampi hi tattha taṃdīpanatthameva vuttattā tadeva jeṭṭhaṃ padhānaṃ tathā veneyyajjhāsayato.
